title: Ukraine War Tracker Update — Sun Jun 7, 2026
summary: Putin rejected Zelensky's June 4 open letter as 'rude' and declared 'no point' in a direct meeting — collapsing the war's most dramatic diplomatic initiative within 48 hours. Putin simultaneously held a private Kremlin meeting with former German Chancellor Schröder (potential backchannel), which EU foreign policy chief Kallas immediately rejected as compromised. Ukraine struck St. Petersburg and Kronstadt naval base for the second time in one week on June 6, with Russia claiming 376 drones intercepted — potentially the largest single Ukrainian drone operation of the war. Russia launched 272 drones at Ukraine overnight (249 downed), killing 3 and wounding 4+ across Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk. ISW confirmed Russian advances in Pokrovsk and Slovyansk while Ukraine held ground in Kostiantynivka. The US House advanced the Ukraine Support Act ($8B military financing); Germany announced an €11.5B package; Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,373,620 by June 7.
